item.title: Yuzawa Snow Country: Ski Resorts Reachable Direct from the Shinkansen — Guide
item.description: Yuzawa is Japan’s most accessible ski region for visitors without a car, thanks to GALA Yuzawa resort’s unique gondola station built directly into Echigo-Yuzawa Shinkansen Station, allowing skiers to travel from central Tokyo to the slopes in under 90 minutes with minimal transfers. The town, part of the ‘snow country’ immortalised in Nobel laureate Yasunari Kawabata’s novel of the same name, hosts numerous resorts of varying difficulty across the surrounding mountains, along with hot springs that make an ideal post-ski relaxation stop.

item.title: Niigata Family Trip: Sado Gold Mine, Gala Yuzawa Snow Play & Rice Paddy Art
item.description: Family Travel Guide to Niigata Prefecture: An Adventure Playground for International Families Niigata Prefecture, stretching along Japan’s Sea of Japan coast, offers families an exceptional blend of cultural experiences, outdoor adventures, and child-friendly attractions that remain refreshingly undiscovered by mass tourism. From underground mine explorations to snow adventures accessible via bullet train, Niigata provides educational and entertaining experiences that engage children while offering parents authentic Japanese regional culture. 1. Sado Gold Mine (佐渡金山): Underground Time Travel The Sado Gold Mine transforms history lessons into genuine adventure for children aged five and above.
